systems.system: Land Management, Information and Technology System (LMITS)
systems.tiers: integrated into the land transaction process, which runs through the notary, the municipality and the registry; project islands Sal, Boa Vista, São Vicente and Maio

note: The evaluation says transaction time was not consistently reduced at the notary or the municipality after the compact (2018-2021), naming internet connectivity among the barriers there, but it does not say how, or whether, the municipal office is connected, nor that municipal staff work in LMITS; no value of any aspect is stated.
